note: status evaluated against the tracked catalyst-config.json; live truth is GET /meta/services

services.name: Serverless Functions
services.statusReason: this API is the dappa_api advanced-I/O function
services.invocation: functions/dappa_api — Express app exported from index.js

services.name: Signals + Event Functions
services.statusReason: CaseMaster insert signal drives the live z-check
services.invocation: functions/dappa_event — AggMonthly upsert + z-check + AnomalyAlert insert

services.name: Cron / Job Scheduling
services.statusReason: dappa_nightly is a Catalyst cron function
services.invocation: functions/dappa_nightly — nightly analytics refresh (Python 3.12)

services.name: AppSail (managed runtime)
services.statusReason: not used — the API runs as an advanced-I/O function; no code path can enable AppSail

services.name: AppSail (custom OCI runtime)
services.statusReason: not used — no custom container is part of this submission

services.name: Signals cross-app event bus
services.statusReason: only the in-project CaseMaster signal is bound; a cross-app subscription is a console step

services.name: Data Store
services.statusReason: every read/write goes through ZCQL
services.invocation: lib/datastore.js — buildZCQL + zcql().executeZCQLQuery, paged at 300 rows

services.name: Data Store full-text Search
services.statusReason: attempted on every /search/cases call; falls through to ZCQL LIKE until the columns are marked searchable in the console
services.invocation: lib/search.js — search().executeSearchQuery over CaseMaster + OffenderProfile

services.name: NoSQL
services.statusReason: association-graph snapshot read from table dappa_network
services.invocation: index.js graphLoaders.nosql — nosql().getTable('dappa_network').fetchItem()

services.name: Stratus (object store)
services.statusReason: bucket 'dappa' holds the graph snapshot, rendered briefs and archived artefacts
services.invocation: index.js — stratus().bucket('dappa').putObject/getObject/generatePreSignedUrl

services.name: File Store
services.statusReason: generated brief artefacts uploaded to the configured folder
services.invocation: lib/artifacts.js — filestore().folder(id).uploadFile/downloadFile

services.name: Cache
services.statusReason: every expensive aggregate is cache-wrapped
services.invocation: lib/cache.js — cache().segment('dappa').put/getValue

services.name: Data Store OLAP database
services.statusReason: flag on but OLAP_ENABLED not set
services.invocation: lib/olap.js — zcql().executeOLAPQuery(sql) for the district x head x month cube and the nightly detect step

services.name: Catalyst Mail
services.statusReason: flag on but MAIL_FROM, DIGEST_TO not set
services.invocation: lib/mail.js — email().sendMail({from_email,to_email,subject,content}); the action-loop digest (lib/actiondigest.js) goes through the same sendDigest

services.name: Push Notifications
services.statusReason: flag on and configured
services.invocation: lib/push.js — pushNotification().web().sendNotification(message, recipients); an alert escalate/assign action (lib/routes/actionlog.js) pushes through the same sendPush

services.name: Circuits (multi-step orchestration)
services.statusReason: Circuits is documented as not available in the IN data centre (docs/CATALYST_SERVICE_RESEARCH.md §3); the in-process fallback serves
services.invocation: lib/circuits.js — circuit().execute(CIRCUIT_ID, 'dappa_nightly_refresh')

services.name: Job Scheduling (job pool + retries)
services.statusReason: flag on but JOB_POOL_NAME not set
services.invocation: lib/jobs.js — jobScheduling().job().submitJob({target_type:'Function', target_name:'dappa_job', jobpool_name, job_config:{number_of_retries, retry_interval}}) / getJob(id); functions/dappa_job is the job-typed target, because a Function pool cannot invoke the cron-typed dappa_nightly, and it calls back into /admin/jobs/run-inline

services.name: Zia Services (text analytics)
services.statusReason: flag on and configured
services.invocation: lib/zia.js — zia().getNERPrediction/getKeywordExtraction/getSentimentAnalysis

services.name: Zia Services (OCR / scanners)
services.statusReason: flag on and configured
services.invocation: lib/zia.js — zia().extractOpticalCharacters(readStream, {language})

services.name: Zia Services (translation / speech)
services.statusReason: flag on but ZIA_TRANSLATE_URL not set
services.invocation: lib/zia.js translate() — POSTs ZIA_TRANSLATE_URL (no zcatalyst-sdk-node binding in v3.4.0)

services.name: Zia Face Analytics (detection quality gate)
services.statusReason: flag on and configured
services.invocation: lib/faces.js qualityGate() — zia().analyseFace(readStream, {mode:'moderate'}) before any comparison

services.name: Zia Identity Scanner (1:1 face comparison)
services.statusReason: flag on and configured
services.invocation: lib/faces.js ziaCompare() — zia().compareFace(galleryStream, probeStream) per shortlisted candidate (≤ FACE_ZIA_MAX_COMPARES, cached 24 h)

services.name: Zia AutoML (tabular)
services.statusReason: Zia AutoML is documented as not available in the IN data centre (docs/CATALYST_SERVICE_RESEARCH.md §5); the in-process fallback serves
services.invocation: lib/zia.js automlPredict() — zia().automl(ZIA_AUTOML_MODEL_ID, features)

services.name: QuickML (no-code ML pipelines)
services.statusReason: flag on but QUICKML_STATUS_ENDPOINT_KEY not set
services.invocation: lib/quickml.js — quickML().predict(QUICKML_STATUS_ENDPOINT_KEY, CaseMaster columns) for case status; QUICKML_ENDPOINT_KEY / deployment URL for the A-vs-C outcome model

services.name: QuickML LLM Serving + RAG
services.statusReason: flag on but QUICKML_LLM_URL not set
services.invocation: lib/routes/actions.js — POSTs QUICKML_LLM_URL with the copilot question

services.name: SmartBrowz (PDF / screenshots)
services.statusReason: flag on and configured; both call sites need a user context this runtime lacks — convertToPdf and takeScreenshot each fail with "No such User with the given id exists" (D-phase8-8), so the print-CSS route and the static map are what a judge sees
services.invocation: index.js smartbrowz.renderBrief — smartbrowz().convertToPdf(printUrl) then Stratus put + pre-signed URL; lib/artifacts.js captureMapSnapshot — smartbrowz().takeScreenshot(mapUrl, {page_options, screenshot_options})

services.name: Zia Services (object recognition / image moderation)
services.statusReason: flag on and configured; the live probe found Zia does not recognise the procedural drawings (nothing on scene_03, the wrong class on scene_02 — D-phase8-4), so the panels serve manifest tags labelled source:fixture; moderation itself answered correctly
services.invocation: lib/objects.js — zia().detectObject(readStream); lib/moderation.js — zia().moderateImage(readStream, {mode})

services.name: QuickML AutoML challenger
services.statusReason: flag on but QUICKML_AUTOML_ENDPOINT_KEY not set
services.invocation: lib/challenger.js — quickML().predict(QUICKML_AUTOML_ENDPOINT_KEY, features) beside the embedded logistic champion

services.name: Catalyst Authentication
services.statusReason: GET /auth/me resolves the Catalyst session on every call; anonymous PUBLIC_DEMO browsing still works
services.invocation: lib/auth.js — userManagement().getCurrentUser() / getAllUsers()

services.name: Connections (OAuth)
services.statusReason: flag on but CONNECTION_LINK_NAME not set
services.invocation: lib/routes/services.js — connections().getConnectionCredentials(CONNECTION_LINK_NAME)

services.name: Slate / Web Client Hosting
services.statusReason: the React client is served as the Catalyst web client for this project
services.invocation: client/dist deployed as the project web client (catalyst deploy)

services.name: API Gateway
services.statusReason: all /server/dappa_api/api/v1 traffic is routed by the Catalyst gateway; rate limits and request ids are enforced in-function
services.invocation: app mounts both /api/v1 and /server/dappa_api/api/v1 so either routing shape resolves

services.name: Domain Mappings
services.statusReason: console-only step; the app runs on the default Catalyst domain

services.name: DevOps: APM + Logs
services.statusReason: enable APM under DevOps > APM in the console and set APM_ENABLED=on; /meta/observability serves in-function telemetry meanwhile
services.invocation: lib/observability.js — request ring buffer behind /meta/observability (Catalyst APM/Logs are console-read only; lib/apminsight in the SDK is the Site24x7 agent and needs a Site24x7 key)

services.name: Pipelines (CI/CD)
services.statusReason: deployment is driven by catalyst deploy; a Pipeline is a console/repo integration step
